scope: The account whole, held for Erasmus's editions and their passage into Stephanus, Beza and the received text.
verified_loci: Erasmus had one mutilated manuscript of the Apocalypse, borrowed from Reuchlin; the last six verses retranslated from the Latin — 'For the Apocalypse he had but one mutilated MS., borrowed from Reuchlin, in which the text and commentary were intermixed almost unintelligibly'
the last six verses wholly wanting — 'This was the case with regard to the last six verses, which from the mutilated condition of his MS. were wholly wanting'
